title: Rate Limiting Rules
description: Define rule-based limits for gateway requests across subjects, models, and metadata.
searchPlaceholder: Search by rule id, model, subject, or metadata key
empty: No rate limiting rules have been created yet.

emptyState.title: No rate limiting rules yet
emptyState.description: Create the first rule to control request and token capacity over defined time windows.

noResults.title: No rules found
noResults.description: Try another search term or clear the current search.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Define when this rule applies based on request subject, model, or metadata.
filters.helper: You can add subject, model, or metadata clauses. Each new clause only offers valid combinations for this rule.
filters.empty: No filters added yet. Use the add filter action to define subject, model, or metadata constraints.
filters.metadataDescription: Add one or more metadata clauses for request attributes.

form.headerDescription: Define a rate limit rule for people, teams, organization units, models, and request metadata.
form.stickyDescription: Saving returns you to the rate limiting rules list.

descriptions.identity: Set the rule identifier, display name, and whether the rule is currently active.
descriptions.ruleId: Allowed characters: English letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
descriptions.name: Helps teammates recognize the rule quickly in lists and reports.
descriptions.description: Describe the purpose or traffic scenario this rule covers.
descriptions.limit: Choose the allowed capacity and the evaluation window for this rule.
descriptions.windowSeconds: When custom mode is selected, the value is interpreted in seconds.
descriptions.advanced: Control how this rule behaves when it overlaps with other rate limit rules.
descriptions.priority: Lower or higher values determine how the rule is evaluated during conflicts.

placeholders.name: Example: public users limit
placeholders.description: What kind of traffic should this rule apply to?

enabled.title: Rule Status
enabled.description: Disabled rules are saved but not enforced on live traffic.

softLimit.title: Soft Limit
softLimit.description: Observe and log the violation instead of blocking the request.

retryAfterHeader.title: Send Retry-After Header
retryAfterHeader.description: Include retry timing guidance when a request is rate limited.

messages.loadError: Failed to load rate limit rules.
messages.saveError: Failed to save rate limit rule.
messages.deleteError: Failed to delete rate limit rule.

deleteDialog.title: Delete rule?
deleteDialog.description: This action will permanently delete rule "{ruleId}".

upgradeDialog.title: This feature is not available on your current plan
upgradeDialog.description: Creating rate limit rules is not included in your current commercial plan. Upgrade your plan to use this feature.
